description: Use this when the user wants their app in the appdesigns gallery (appdesigns.click/apps): a screenshot set they saved (asset_id, from save_to_account or list_projects) is sent for review as a template other makers start from, listed with the app's icon, name and store link, so other makers get inspiration and the user gets seen. A person reviews it within 24 to 48 hours and the user gets an email when it is live. The set needs at least 3 screens, an App Store or Google Play link, and an icon: taken from the App Store link (Apple's public lookup), else the project's icon in appdesigns, else icon. Ask the user before calling it: the listing is public. Needs the user signed in to appdesigns; a call without it fails asking for sign-in, and then the user signs in (in Claude Code type /mcp, pick appdesigns and choose Authenticate (or run `claude mcp login appdesigns` in a separate terminal), in Codex run `codex mcp login appdesigns`; other agents open the sign-in page themselves).

app_name.description: The app's name as the store shows it.

app_store_url.description: The app's App Store page, https://apps.apple.com/... (this or play_store_url, or both).

description.description: One line about the app, shown on its gallery page.

icon.description: An https URL of the app icon (square; on appdesigns.click, Supabase storage or Apple's image CDN). Leave it out: the icon comes from the App Store link, else the project's icon.

play_store_url.description: The app's Google Play page, https://play.google.com/...

x_handle.description: The maker's X handle, if they want to be tagged when the listing is shared on X (a handle or a profile link).

name: feature_app
title: Feature the app in the appdesigns gallery
